examples.arabic: أحمد مشي للمطعم الأول واداهم أربع شنط.
examples.english: Ahmed walked to the first restaurant and gave them four bags.
examples.transliteration: Ahmad meshi lel-matam el-awwal wa edahom arbaa shonat.

examples.arabic: انا هكمل مشي معاها عشان انا جعان
examples.english: I will continue walking with her because I am hungry.
examples.transliteration: ana hakammel mashy maaha ashan ana gaan

examples.arabic: صاحبي مشي معايا عشان نختار مع بعض
examples.english: My friend walked with me so we could choose together.
examples.transliteration: Sahby meshy maaya ashan nekhtar ma baad.
